rationale: The production roadmap requires secure HTTP headers for HSTS, CSP and frame protection. Adding a FastAPI middleware changes the public HTTP response contract across API routes, so this is a D3 cross-cutting security change.

steps: Remove the focused security header tests.
Run tests/api/test_security_headers.py and a health-route smoke test to confirm prior behavior.

fidelity_test.description: Verify API responses include HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, referrer and permissions headers.
pre_conditions: Middleware is tested on an isolated Starlette app.
steps: Assert normal API responses receive the restrictive API CSP.
Assert docs routes receive a docs-compatible CSP.
Assert an existing explicit CSP header is not overwritten.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Security headers are consistently attached without breaking existing explicit CSP behavior.
